A.title: Cognitive Effects in Large Language Models
A.venue: Frontiers in artificial intelligence and applications

paradigms.name: Semantic priming (lexical decision on spaced-letter targets after associated vs unrelated prime)
Symbolic distance effect (comparison of animals, numbers, months, letters)
SNARC effect (spatial-numerical association: magnitude, parity classification, horizontal and vertical)
Size congruity effect (capitalisation as font-size analogue)
Anchoring effect (code-completion estimate of string length after small vs large anchor)

E.headline: GPT-3 shows priming, distance, SNARC and size congruity effects but not anchoring; effects may be imitated or reinvented.

G.notes: Single model, no human data: effects judged against published human findings only. Confidence = logprob share (deterministic), not sampled responses; temperature declared irrelevant. Mental-load spacing and capitalisation are ad hoc analogues of reaction time and font size. Several effects absent or reversed (months, letters, anchoring 3-4).
